facts.fact: The article states that Niger's DHIS2 system, which it describes as the national routine health management information system, is hosted within the Directorate of Statistics at the Ministry of Health; it gives no date for this, so the published date is used.

systems.owner: Directorate of Statistics, Ministry of Health
systems.tiers: operational-level health workers, tiers not specified

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, developed with HISP West Africa

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, developed with HISP West Africa

note: Most of the article concerns DHIS2 used for a 2024 vaccination campaign and coverage survey, which are not the hmis class. It says health workers use DHIS2 routinely but names no tier and no place of data entry. An integration of DHIS2 with STELab (laboratory specimens and case-based surveillance) is described as current.
